name: Cassava leaves
description: Pounded cassava leaves cooked for hours — they must be, or they are toxic.

tcm.note: Outside the classical record; read with the leafy greens; long cooking is required.

unani.note: Outside the classical record; placed with greens.

histamine.note: Low for histamine. Raw cassava leaves contain cyanogens, which is why they are boiled for hours.

nutrition.highlight: hours of boiling, not by choice
